modmenu.descriptionTranslation.imperium_: European empire simulation expansion for MineColonies.
imperium_realms.gui.title: IMPERIAL LEDGER
imperium_realms.gui.help: Tax and policy controls submit bills. The Emperor reviews them in Parliament; all actions are server-validated.
com.imperium_realms.building.imperial_ar: A five-tier administrative, scholarly and diplomatic hut for Philosophers, Tax Collectors and Diplomats. Original Structurize blueprints are included.
imperium_realms.message.player_required: This command must be used by a player in a MineColonies colony.
imperium_realms.message.enter_colony: Stand inside a MineColonies colony to access its imperial ledger.
imperium_realms.message.ledger_missing: The imperial ledger could not initialize for this colony.
imperium_realms.message.tax_unchanged: Tax rate unchanged. Choose a rate from 0 to 25 percent.
imperium_realms.message.tax_proposal_inv: Cannot propose %1$d%% tax: the rate is invalid, already active, or an identical open proposal exists. Current rate: %2$d%%.
imperium_realms.message.tax_proposed: Tax proposal #%1$d submitted: %2$d%%. Council votes: %3$d for, %4$d against. Expires after day %5$d. Use /imperium parliament status, then assent or veto #%1$d.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_empty: There are no saved parliamentary proposals.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_propo: Bill #%1$d (%2$s): %3$s by %4$s §7| Council: %5$d for / %6$d against §7| Status: %7$s §7| Expires day %8$d §7| Resolved by %9$s on day %10$s
imperium_realms.message.parliament_instr: Use /imperium parliament propose-policy <policy> to submit policy bills, /imperium parliament assent <id> to approve, or /imperium parliament veto <id> to reject a bill.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_propo: No parliamentary bill with ID #%1$d exists.
Parliamentary bill #%1$d is no longer open.
Bill #%1$d passed. The daily tax rate is now %2$d%%.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_no_ma: The council's votes blocked bill #%1$d; the parliamentary majority was not reached.
imperium_realms.message.policy_unknown: Unknown policy. Choose balanced, mercantile, welfare, or austerity.
imperium_realms.message.policy_proposal_: Cannot propose policy %1$s: it is already active or an identical open proposal exists. Current policy: %2$s.
imperium_realms.message.policy_proposed: Policy proposal #%1$d submitted: %2$s. Council votes: %3$d for, %4$d against. Expires after day %5$d.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_polic: Bill #%1$d passed. Economic policy is now %2$s.
imperium_realms.message.policy_changed: Economic policy changed to %1$s. Its tax and stability effects apply on the next daily turn.
imperium_realms.message.invest_multiple: Investments must be a multiple of 10 crowns.
imperium_realms.message.treasury_insuffi: The treasury does not contain enough crowns.
imperium_realms.message.invest_success: Invested %1$d crowns into %2$d knowledge point(s). Treasury balance: %3$d crowns.
imperium_realms.message.permission_denie: You need colony hut-management permission or operator permission to change the imperial economy.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_empty: No diplomatic relations have been recorded yet.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_instru: Use /imperium diplomacy improve <colonyId> to spend 10 influence and improve that relation by 5 points. A Diplomat at the Imperial Archive generates influence.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_target: No MineColonies colony with ID #%1$d was found in this dimension.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_self_t: A colony cannot improve diplomatic relations with itself.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_influe: You need at least 10 diplomatic influence to improve a relation.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_relati: Relations with %1$s are already at the maximum score.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_improv: The diplomatic relation could not be changed.
Relations with %1$s improved to %2$s (%3$d/100). Remaining influence: %4$d.
imperium_realms.message.politics_help: Use /imperium politics to review faction approval. Lower taxes, citizen happiness and Welfare policy can reduce unrest over time. Strikes halve tax income; revolts reduce it to 10%.
com.imperium_realms.building.imperial_gu: A five-tier specialist guard tower for Imperial Siege Engineers, Field Medics and Cavaliers. Original Structurize blueprints are included.
imperium_realms.message.army_help: Specialist guard level-ups train these disciplines. Use an Imperial Guard Tower to hire the native MineColonies roles; custom Structurize blueprints are still required for survival construction.
imperium_realms.message.province_help: Use /imperium province focus <agriculture|trade|scholarship|military|civic> to specialize. /imperium province develop spends 10 knowledge to advance the province.
imperium_realms.message.province_focus_u: Unknown province focus. Choose agriculture, trade, scholarship, military, or civic.
The province is already specialized in %1$s.
imperium_realms.message.province_focus_s: Province focus changed to %1$s. Its effects apply on the server's daily turn.
imperium_realms.message.province_fully_d: This province has reached the highest administrative tier.
imperium_realms.message.province_knowled: Developing a province costs 10 knowledge points.
imperium_realms.message.province_develop: The province could not be developed.
Province advanced toward %1$s. Development: %2$d/1000. Remaining knowledge: %3$d.
